hard_contraindications: NO breath retentions (kumbhaka) > 3 seconds (strictly exclude 4-7-8 and box breathing)
NO rapid or forceful hyperventilation (strictly exclude Kapalabhati, Bhastrika, Wim Hof)
NO unanchored deep visceral body scans or forced eye-closure commands (always use invitational open-eye permission)
NO rapid saccadic eye movements (unsupervised EMDR) or cervical hyperextension > 30 degrees
NO deep emotional trauma or memory probing (maintain 100% somatic/tactile presence)

practices.name: The Neuro-Ocular Vagal Reset
practices.clinical_source: Stanley Rosenberg (Accessing the Healing Power of the Vagus Nerve)

phase_1_entry_0_8s.symptom_mirror_hook: Notice if the muscles at the base of your skull feel rock hard right now.
phase_1_entry_0_8s.entry_cue: Interlace your fingers and rest them behind your head, cradling the base of your skull.

phase_2_coregulation_8_28s.somatic_execution: Keep your head facing forward. Shift both eyes 30 degrees to the right, looking toward your elbow. Hold your gaze steady.
phase_2_coregulation_8_28s.physiological_marker: Wait for the involuntary swallow, deep sigh, or yawn that signals suboccipital release.

phase_3_nondual_bridge_28_42s.english: Bring your eyes back to center. Notice the sudden softness. You are the still awareness resting behind the gaze.
phase_3_nondual_bridge_28_42s.hindi: Aankhein seedhi karein. Netron ka tanaav chhutte hi jo thehraav bachta hai, wahi 'Sakshi' hai.
phase_3_nondual_bridge_28_42s.punjabi: Akhan sidhiyan karo. Khichaav mukk jaanda hai ate andar 'Sehaj' da thehraav vaggda hai.

practices.name: The Double-Inhale Physiological Sigh
practices.clinical_source: Andrew Huberman & David Spiegel (Stanford Medicine RCT)

phase_1_entry_0_8s.symptom_mirror_hook: If your heart is beating fast and your chest feels tightly clamped...
phase_1_entry_0_8s.entry_cue: Take a deep breath in through your nose... and at the very top, take one more sharp sip of air.

phase_2_coregulation_8_28s.somatic_execution: Now open your mouth and let it all go in one long, extended sigh of relief.
phase_2_coregulation_8_28s.physiological_marker: Re-inflates collapsed alveoli and triggers cardiac vagal braking without holding breath.

phase_3_nondual_bridge_28_42s.english: Notice the silence left when the breath empties. You do not need to fight for calm; presence is already here.
phase_3_nondual_bridge_28_42s.hindi: Saans khali hote hi jo vishraam ubharta hai—us mein thehar jayein. Aap poori tarah surakshit hain.
phase_3_nondual_bridge_28_42s.punjabi: Saans bahar nikalde hi man da shor tham jaanda hai. Akal di shanti tuhade andar hi hai.

practices.name: The Heart-Forehead Somatic Containment Hold
practices.clinical_source: Peter A. Levine (In an Unspoken Voice) & Deb Dana

phase_1_entry_0_8s.symptom_mirror_hook: If you feel fragmented or like you are holding yourself together by a thread...
phase_1_entry_0_8s.entry_cue: Place one gentle palm across your forehead, and the other palm flat over your chest.

phase_2_coregulation_8_28s.somatic_execution: Apply 5% gentle, reassuring pressure. Feel the temperature between your skin and your hands. Feel the boundary of your body.
phase_2_coregulation_8_28s.physiological_marker: Oxytocin release via cutaneous C-tactile mechanoreceptors; downregulates amygdala panic.

phase_3_nondual_bridge_28_42s.english: Feel the boundary of your skin. Everything inside is held. Presence holds you; you can let go.
phase_3_nondual_bridge_28_42s.hindi: Apne haathon ki garmi ko mehsus karein. Sharir ek mandir hai. Is thehraav mein Shiva ka sukoon hai.
phase_3_nondual_bridge_28_42s.punjabi: Tan di seema nu mehsoos karo. Sehaj da hath tuhade sir te hai. Sab bojh lath jaanda hai.

phase_1_entry_0_8s.symptom_mirror_hook: If your gut feels frozen, hollow, or numb with heavy exhaustion...
phase_1_entry_0_8s.entry_cue: Inhale gently into your belly. We are going to make a deep, low foghorn sound on the exhale: 'Voooooo'.

phase_2_coregulation_8_28s.somatic_execution: Release: Voooooooooooo. Let the vibration rumble low in your solar plexus, diaphragm, and pelvis.
phase_2_coregulation_8_28s.physiological_marker: 80–130 Hz acoustic resonance directly massages visceral organs and stimulates motor fibers of CN X.

phase_3_nondual_bridge_28_42s.english: Feel the vibration settle into stillness. The body hums, but the space hearing it is untouched.
phase_3_nondual_bridge_28_42s.hindi: Goonj ko shaant hone dein. Chidakash mein thehar jayein—jahan koi tanaav tik nahi sakta.
phase_3_nondual_bridge_28_42s.punjabi: Goonj de thamde hi andar da Simran jaagda hai. Tusi oh noor ho jo har goonj nu sun reha hai.

practices.name: Fine-Motor Sympathetic Tremor & Shoulder Drop
practices.clinical_source: Peter A. Levine (In an Unspoken Voice)

phase_1_entry_0_8s.symptom_mirror_hook: Check where your shoulders are right now. Are they braced up toward your ears?
phase_1_entry_0_8s.entry_cue: Drop your arms down loose. Gently flick and shake your wrists for 10 seconds, like shaking off water.

phase_2_coregulation_8_28s.somatic_execution: Inhale: lift your shoulders slightly up. Exhale: drop them completely into gravity with an audible breath.
phase_2_coregulation_8_28s.physiological_marker: Completes trapped fight-or-flight motor loop without high-arousal cardiovascular spikes.

phase_3_nondual_bridge_28_42s.english: Notice the tingling warmth spreading through your fingers. When the shaking stops, the unshakeable remains.
phase_3_nondual_bridge_28_42s.hindi: Ungliyon ki sansanahath ko dekhein. Jab halchal rukti hai, tab shuddh thehraav prakat hota hai.
phase_3_nondual_bridge_28_42s.punjabi: Hatha di garmi nu mehsoos karo. Jad koshish thamdi hai, taan Sehaj avastha mildi hai.

phase_1_entry_0_8s.symptom_mirror_hook: Looking at a screen for hours puts the eyes into sympathetic tunnel vision.
phase_1_entry_0_8s.entry_cue: Soften the focus of your eyes right now. Without moving your head, notice what is at the outer edges of your vision.

phase_2_coregulation_8_28s.somatic_execution: Widen your gaze into panoramic vision. Feel the solid weight of your pelvis in your seat and heels on the floor.
phase_2_coregulation_8_28s.physiological_marker: Deactivates dorsal attentional threat monitoring; re-engages peripheral safety circuitry.

phase_3_nondual_bridge_28_42s.english: You are not trapped inside your skull. You are the open space in which the whole room appears.
phase_3_nondual_bridge_28_42s.hindi: Aap sirf sharir nahi hain. Aap wahi anant aakash hain jismein yeh saara sansaar thehra hai.
phase_3_nondual_bridge_28_42s.punjabi: Apne aap nu bhatkan ton mod ke dekho. Akal purakh da pasaara tuhade chaare paase hai.
